# Financial reporting automation

*Client industry: finance | Completed: 2021-09-11 | Evidence id: data_analyst:case:p05*

## The problem
The client was a finance team building month-end reports by hand.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using spreadsheet models with pivot tables, Python, dataframe-based data wrangling, extract-transform-load jobs. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project cut month-end close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.
